layouts.name: Tor Jastrzab
layouts.description: The operator identifies the Autodrom Jastrzab training and motorsport complex. This configuration uses both Northern hairpins, the long Western return and its small infield hairpin, the central triangular-island return and Eastern S bends. The Southern connection crosses the paved training apron and bypasses the separate Southern skid circle. The route is independently digitized from freely reusable GUGiK government orthoimagery because the public map omits the Northern return and several source ways contain angular shortcuts. All pixel anchors are picked on visible pavement in the government raster; neither catalogue picture vertices nor timing GPS set course coordinates. The independently measured 1741.0 m versus the catalogue 1715 m is retained, with a 45 m allowance for provisional centerline and historical temporary-cone alignment. Direction, temporary barriers and corner alignment remain draft. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 1741.0 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
